results.title: Cars.com Inc. - Form ARS - FY2022
results.snippet: Cars.com is a digital marketplace and solutions provider for the automotive industry, connecting car shoppers with dealers. The Company sells marketplace subscription advertising products to dealer customers, enabling dealers to showcase their vehicle inventory to in-market car shoppers.

results.title: Cars.com Inc. - Form 10-12B/A - FY2017
results.snippet: Cars.com generates revenue primarily through the sale of online subscription advertising products to car dealer customers, which enable dealers access to their high-quality, in-market audience of car shoppers through vehicle inventory listings.

results.title: Cars.com Inc. - Form 10-12B/A - FY2017
results.snippet: Cars.com sells marketplace subscription advertising to dealer customers through varying packages, which allow dealers to showcase their available new and used vehicle inventory to an extensive audience of in-market car shoppers.

results.title: Cars.com Inc. - Form 8-K - FY2017
results.snippet: Cars.com is a leading online automotive marketplace that connects car shoppers with dealers and private sellers. The company offers subscription advertising products and display advertising solutions to franchise and independent dealers across the United States.

results.title: Cars.com Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2019
results.snippet: Cars.com provides digital marketplace solutions to automotive dealers, including marketplace subscription advertising, display advertising, and audience extension products. These products allow dealers and manufacturers to extend their reach on other advertising networks.

results.title: Cars.com Strategy and Business Model
results.snippet: Cars.com is a North American automotive marketplace and dealer-technology company that sells subscription advertising products and digital services to car dealerships and automotive manufacturers. The company's digital services include dealer websites, digital marketing, and online retail technology.
